text: Came for lunch and waited almost 40 minutes for a plate of chicken rice. Food was fine but the wait is ridiculous for a hawker stall.
排队等了半个多小时才拿到食物，中午人手明显不够。味道还可以，但等太久了。
The sambal here is incredible, best I have had in the east. Auntie was so warm and even remembered my order from last time.
Meja tak dilap, lengket dengan minyak. Lantai pun kotor. Makanan sedap tapi kebersihan kena jaga.
45 minutes for two plates of noodles at lunchtime. The queue was out the door and only one person was cooking. Never again on a weekday.
மதிய உணவுக்கு நாற்பது நிமிடம் காத்திருக்க வேண்டியிருந்தது. உணவு நன்றாக இருந்தது, ஆனால் காத்திருப்பு நேரம் மிக அதிகம்.
周末中午来，等了差不多40分钟。厨房只有一个人在炒，队伍很长。食物没问题，就是太慢。
Uncle at the stall is a legend, always cheerful even during the rush. Portions are generous and the price has not gone up in years.
Harga naik lagi, sekarang lapan ringgit untuk nasi ayam biasa. Rasa okay je, tak sepadan dengan harga.
Lunch service is broken. Ordered at 12:15, got my food at 1:05. Almost an hour. The staff know it is bad, they keep apologising but nothing changes.
中午12点半来，等到1点15分才有位子和食物。人手太少，一个人根本忙不过来。以后不敢午餐时间来了。
மதியம் ஒரு மணிக்கு வந்தேன், உணவு வர ஐம்பது நிமிடம் ஆனது. வேலையாட்கள் போதவில்லை. உணவு சூடாக இல்லை, அவ்வளவு நேரம் காத்ததால்.
Saturday lunch, waited 55 minutes. This is the third weekend in a row it has been like this. Whatever changed a month ago, please change it back.
Tengah hari sangat lambat. Menunggu hampir sejam untuk mee goreng. Satu orang je masak masa lunch rush, memang tak larat.
Dinner on a weeknight was a totally different experience, quick and quiet. The hor fun had great wok hei. Come after 7pm and you are fine.
阿姨人很好，服务态度一流。晚上来吃很舒服，没什么人排队。菜的味道一直都很稳定。
The curry was lukewarm when it reached me, like it had been sitting out. Taste was there but I had to ask them to heat it up again.
Tray return area was overflowing and nobody cleared it for the whole time I was there. Tables sticky. The food deserves a cleaner setting.
நான் கோழி பிரியாணி கேட்டேன், அவர்கள் ஆட்டு பிரியாணி கொடுத்தார்கள். திரும்பக் கொடுக்க மறுத்தார்கள். கவனக்குறைவு.
Bising sangat masa lunch, susah nak dengar orang bercakap. Kipas pun rosak, panas. Makanan tetap sedap macam biasa.
Still the best value lunch in the neighbourhood if you come early. Was seated and eating within ten minutes at 11:15am.
份量比以前少了很多，价钱却一样。一小块鸡肉配一堆饭，吃不饱。
